finding.title: gRPC stream metadata count preallocates unreceived images
finding.provenance: Actual GRPCDocumentReader.Read with fake stream containing metadata count 100000 and no images; observes cap100000. Does not allocate malicious uint32 max/OOM. Protocol count is best-effort so mismatch itself is not flagged.
finding.validation: Full docparser package passes; actual GRPCDocumentReader.Read consumes controlled stream frames. Counts0/1/100000 with0/4 actual frames exercise unknown/under/over estimates; image order/content retained. Allocation grows only with actual frames. No max-image-count imposed, no uint32-max allocation attempted.

root_review: Complete source diff and test reviewed. Allocation now follows received frames; best-effort count contract retained.
limitations: Safe bounded memory repro and fake gRPC stream; no deliberate OOM or real docreader call. Broader parser audit remains partial.
